records.japanese: <select><value:$33>貴様のくる所ではない。帰れ。<end>他の国は知らないがアキュリュースは平和な<line-break>もんだよ。ミズチがいる限り他国も攻めて<line-break>きやしないから、警備の仕事は暇なんだ。<end>勇者ネメアがディンガルの皇帝になったのは　　<line-break>知っていても、その部下で朱雀将軍に任命された<line-break>アンギルダンって爺さんが魔王バロルの時代に<line-break>ここの傭兵隊長をしていたなんてことは<line-break>知らないだろう。ま、俺も隊長に教えて<line-break>もらうまで知らなかったんだけどね。<end>東方諸国の盟主ロセンがディンガルに<line-break>滅ぼされたそうだな。あの国は国王のペウダが<line-break>愚王と呼ばれるぐらいひどい国だったからな。<line-break>国民は案外、ディンガルの占領を喜んでいたり<line-break>するんじゃないか。ま、このことでディンガル<line-break>にとって東方の脅威はなくなったわけだ。<end>我々の仕事は、この地に住む人々を守ることだ。<line-break>そのためには日々の鍛錬を忘れてはならない。<line-break>それは冒険者も同じだよな？<end>ミズチがいなくなれば抵抗はできないよ。<line-break>ディンガル帝国の軍事力は強大だからね。<line-break>君もそう思うだろ？<end>ミズチがいなくなって自由に船が<line-break>行き来できるようになったんだ。<line-break>おかげで不法侵入者の監視がたいへんだよ。<end>結局、ネメアの世界征服は何だったのかな？<line-break>いらぬ混乱を招いただけだと思うけど。<end>
records.english: <select><value:$33>You have no business here. Leave.<end>I can't speak for other countries, but Aqyurius is peaceful enough. As long as the Mizuchi are here, no foreign power will attack, so guard duty is dull work.<end>You may know that Hero Nemea became emperor of Dyneskal, but I doubt you know that one of his subordinates, an old man named Angeerdan who was appointed Vermilion Bird General, once commanded the mercenaries here in the days of Balor, Demon King. Well, I didn't know either until the captain told me.<end>I hear Rocen, leader of the Eastern Nations, has been destroyed by Dyneskal. Peuda was such a terrible king that he was known as the Fool King, so his subjects may actually be glad of the occupation. In any case, Dyneskal no longer faces a threat from the east.<end>Our duty is to protect the people who live here. To do that, we must never neglect our daily training. The same goes for adventurers, wouldn't you say?<end>Without the Mizuchi, we couldn't put up any resistance. The military might of the Dyneskal Empire is overwhelming. You agree, don't you?<end>Now that the Mizuchi are gone, ships can come and go freely. That has made keeping watch for trespassers much harder.<end>In the end, what did Nemea's conquest of the world accomplish? I think it only caused needless chaos.<end>
